title: Wear OS collector to send data to NightScout
body:
Afaik, Wear OS xDrip apk current can transmit data using native xDrip follower mode when works as a standalone collector. But that requires a Google service installed/running on the watch. 

Would be great to have an option to send readings to NightScout from WearOS collector in case Google services are missing. A great example is Xiaomi Mi Watch - an excellent watch with affordable price with a great HW but missing Google services. 

I confirm that xDrip runs perfectly on them and standalone collector works with no issues. Only followers option is missing.

Yes, at now there is this options : 
Libre1 + Miao -> Xdrip WearOS  directly

Libre2 ->              Juggluco WearOS directly

           ->              Xdrip WearOS + oop2 directly
